critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main deck window row' primitive array to implement variable spacing. Instead of a uniform distribution, apply a linear interpolation (lerp) to the X-position of each window: increase the gap between windows by 15% in the front and rear sections of the fuselage, while maintaining standard spacing in the mid-section to accommodate door placements.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage side.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck) with specific spacing.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Duplicate and offset the window primitive to create a second upper-deck row.

discrepancies.observed: A straight, flat cylinder for the upper deck section.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct 'hump' that curves smoothly into the main fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Taper and curve the front of the upper deck primitive to blend with the nose.

discrepancies.observed: No visible door frames or structural breaks in the fuselage geometry.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular door outlines along the side.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Add small, thin rectangular planes at specific intervals along the fuselage sides.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Variable spacing with larger gaps around doors and cockpit area.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Increase the distance between window primitives near the front and rear sections.
